title: Brand configuration
description: Product name, colours, icons, identifiers and hosts of one *-next product (@shared-next/brand). Renaming the product means editing brand.config.json, regenerating (pnpm brand:gen) and rebuilding; no product name is hard-coded elsewhere. Optional fields exist for the products that use them; a product makes them mandatory with parseBrandConfig(value, { require: [...] }).

colors.description: Colours around the page (web manifest, browser chrome, native splash). Each product keeps them equal to its design tokens. primary is the accent (--c-primary-solid), theme a dedicated toolbar colour, background the light page background, backgroundDark the dark one.

icon.description: Master icon relative to the product's brand root: an SVG the generator draws the favicon and PNG icons from, or a pre-rendered PNG.

iconMaskable.description: Full-bleed icon whose artwork stays inside the central 80% circle: manifest maskable icons and the Apple touch icon.

webInstall.description: Whether the web app links, serves and emits the web manifest and icons (installable site).

appIds.description: Store and bundle identifiers of the Capacitor shells (iOS, Android). There is no native desktop app: desktop is the installable web app (PWA). Changing one makes the store treat it as a different app.

urlScheme.description: Private-use URI scheme (RFC 8252): deep links and the native OIDC redirect the IdP registers.

hostTemplates.description: Hosts of one tenant; {domain} is the tenant's domain.

sharedDomains.description: Registrable domains shared by every tenant and never under a tenant's domain, so their content is not same-site with the app.

devOrigins.description: Extra origins accepted only by development builds.

pushSenderName.description: Title of push notifications that hide the message.
